One Rule Short

STS-HS9-L4-6501000-HSSCIENG910-MCF-AAD-01 • HS Science Engineering Design 9-10 • Specifying Constraints from Societal Needs and Risk
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
In Ghana, builders grow bamboo, cut it, and lash it into bicycle frames that carry people to school and to market. A bike that cannot be fixed in the village with hand tools is a bike that dies on its first bad road, so repairability is written down as a rule before anyone builds anything. Engineers call those written rules constraints, and a design has to earn its way past every one of them.
If your school built bamboo bikes for students riding on rough roads, what is one rule you would add to that board, and what risk would it protect against?
